parsed.notes: Amendment No. 1 (Feb 26, 2026) raised the maximum Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio from 4.25x to 5.00x for quarters ending March 31, 2026 through December 31, 2026, stepping down to 4.75x for March 31, 2027 through June 30, 2027. The 5.00x limit applies at June 30, 2026. The leverage-based pricing grid on the term loan and the commitment fee terms are not covenants and are excluded.
